extracted.name: Breakfast Rice from Japan
extracted.description: This breakfast rice recipe combines leftover white or brown rice with scrambled egg and soy sauce for a deliciously crispy and filling breakfast.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup cold cooked rice, or more to taste
2 green onions, sliced, or more to taste
2 teaspoons soy sauce, or to taste
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Spread rice in a flat layer in hot oil; cook until crispy on the bottom, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir egg into rice until scrambled, about 2 minutes more. Sprinkle green onions on top and season with soy sauce.
